title: 第9章 房屋转租
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

穿越倒计时：5天。

今天约好了，早上八点在小区门口见面。

可谭筝左等右等，就是没瞧见人影。

难道被放鸽子了？

谭筝有些生气，她现在的时间，每一分每一秒都很宝贵，可经不起这么浪费。

正当她准备问个清楚的时候，对方先弹了消息过来。

“你人呢？我都等你十分钟了……/(ㄒoㄒ)/~~”

嗯？已经到了吗？可她没看见啊。

谭筝原地转了一圈，除了来去匆匆的路人，就只有角落里一个花臂壮汉背对着她。

她有些迟疑……总不可能是他吧？

谭筝不死心，问了一句：“我已经在小区门口了，你今天穿的是什么颜色的衣服？”

对方立刻回复：“黑色。”

黑色？？？难道真是他？

谭筝壮着胆子上前问：“你好，请问你的ID是可爱喵喵侠吗？”

听到有人跟自己说话，那壮汉噌地一下站起来，目测身高一米九，跟座铁塔似的。

“是我！原来你就是AAA打铁谭哥啊？！”

“咳咳咳，是我，是我。”谭筝有些尴尬地咳嗽了两声。

两个人这才正式接上了头。

“走吧，我带你去看一下房子。”

“好。”

路过中央处的空地时，有晨练的大爷一边拍打自己的腋下，一边嘿哈嘿哈地大叫着。

“额，这个小区里住着不少老人，有的老人喜欢晨练，一般从早上六点开始，九点左右结束，如果是上晚班的话，早上可能会被吵醒。”

谭筝顺道说了一下这事。

“六点到九点……”李耀念叨了两句，点了点头。

谭筝看他面色如常，心里默默地松了一口气。

这晨练的大爷大妈还都是开胃小菜呢，连这个都接受不了，那后头的就更不用看了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Countdown to time travel: 5 days.

We made an appointment today to meet at the gate of the community at eight o'clock in the morning.

But Tan Zheng waited and waited, but saw no one.

Could it be that he was let go?

Tan Zheng was a little angry. Every minute and every second of her time now was precious, but she couldn't afford to waste it like this.

Just when she was about to ask clearly, the other party sent the message first.

"Where are you? I've been waiting for you for ten minutes.../(ㄒoㄒ)/~~"

Huh?Already arrived?But she didn't see it.

Tan Zheng walked around in a circle. Apart from passers-by, there was only a strong man with colorful arms in the corner, his back to her.

She hesitated...it couldn't be him, could it?

Tan Zheng refused to give up and asked, "I'm already at the gate of the community. What color are you wearing today?"

The other party immediately replied: "Black."

Black???Is it really him?

Tan Zheng bravely stepped forward and asked, "Hello, is your ID the Mew Mew Man?"

When he heard someone talking to him, the strong man stood up suddenly. He was 1.9 meters tall, like an iron tower.

"It's me! So you are Brother Tan from AAA?!"

"Cough, cough, cough, it's me, it's me." Tan Zheng coughed twice in embarrassment.

Only then did the two people officially connect.

"Come on, I'll take you to see the house."

"Okay."

When passing by the open space in the center, an old man doing morning exercises slapped his armpits and shouted hehehehe.

"Well, there are many old people living in this community. Some old people like to do morning exercises. They usually start at six o'clock in the morning and end around nine o'clock. If you work the night shift, you may be woken up in the morning."

Tan Zheng mentioned this incident in passing.

"Six to nine..." Li Yao muttered a few words and nodded.

Tan Zheng saw that his expression was as normal and he breathed a sigh of relief silently.

The uncles and aunts who do morning exercises are just appetizers. If they can't even accept this, let alone the ones that follow.
